Ivy: Quick shout  Solstice Data is live via the GCP Marketplace ISV Private Offer on Redwood Dedicated (region: europe-west2) as of 08:46 UTC. Team crushed it. :tada:
Ben: Amazing! Any early signals on perf or cost delta?
Karim: Initial numbers: p95 for report-generation calls ~140ms at 95 req/s. Estimated infra token cost down ~48% after int8 quant + caching.
DeployBot: deployment/solstice-data/marketplace succeeded at 08:46:20 (duration 98s) :white_check_mark:
Ivy: Can someone drop a 3-line blurb + one metric we can use for the marketplace tile? Also need legal approval for name/quote.
Marta: Draft blurb: "Solstice Data reduced inference costs by ~48% and improved tail latency for analytics reports, enabled by Redwood Dedicated's KV prefix caching and optimized batching."
Ben: Nice. Add the model callout: "redwood-gpt-7b-1.1" and mention cross-region DR is configured.
Karim: Config snippet used:
```
deployment:
  mode: dedicated
  pool: sd-eu-dedicated-02
  model: redwood-gpt-7b-1.1
  batching: latency-aware
  kv_cache: prefix
  quantization: int8
```
Ivy: Perfect. @Comms pls coordinate the quote + legal sign-off. I'll post to #all-hands once cleared.
Comms: On it  I'll send the permission template and request a short customer quote (privacy-safe). ETA EOD.
Ben: Scheduling an exec brief next Tue to surface cost savings and SLA. Thanks everyone. Huge team effort. :clap:
